newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Colonial in Alltel deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Colonial in Alltel deal.

text.p: Life office and banking group Colonial Ltd said on Thursday it had reached an information technology outsourcing agreement with Alltel Information Services of the United States worth A$532 million over seven years.
Colonial, a mutual which plans to float on the stock exchange later this calendar year, said the Alltel Corp unit was the successful tenderer to provide its banking information technology services.
It said Alltel would assist in the re-engineering of Colonial's banking software systems with relevant Colonial staff having the opportunity for employment under the new agreement.
